data.detailed_description:
The game is in active development.

⚠️ The game is under active development. Some mechanics, content, and balance may change over time or be temporarily unavailable. We would greatly appreciate your feedback!


About the Game

🔹 SHORT DESCRIPTION

An experimental role-playing game about living life after life in a constantly changing world.

The world is continuously regenerated, stories intertwine, and bonds between characters can survive even death.

🔹 ABOUT THE GAME

This is a game about life, choices, and consequences — where every new beginning isn’t a restart, but a continuation of the story.

The core feature of the game is living life after life, discovering the world anew each time.
Locations, events, and objects can mix, shift, or regenerate, creating a unique experience in every cycle.

But the world is not just places.
It’s people.

🔹 Sociology & Relationships

One of the key elements of the game is relationships, social connections, and character stories that can carry over between lives.

  • NPCs don’t simply disappear — they continue their own cycle

  • You may meet familiar characters in a new life, or even in another world

  • Past decisions leave a mark, even if the world has changed

🌍 The “What If…” World

The goal of the project is to create a living world inspired by reality, but built around one key word:
“what if”.

What if dinosaurs never went extinct?
What if women dominated the world?
What if aliens conquered humanity?
What if the Roman Empire never fell… or never existed at all?

For now, the main focus is fantasy, but in the future the world may expand into different parallel realities.

⏳ Live It, Don’t Just Finish It

The gameplay cycle is designed to last around 2–3 real days:

  • you live a life through a chosen profession

  • you can change your path, but every choice has consequences

  • stories are meant to be lived, not simply “completed”

🔁 Progress Between Lives

After a life ends, you return to the beginning — but not empty-handed.

There is global progression shared across all cycles:

  • experience accumulated across all lives

  • permanent bonuses

  • unique abilities and traits you can take into a new cycle

🚧 Development & Future Plans

The game is an experimental project.
Mechanics, balance, and even certain concepts may evolve over time.

The game does not have a “final” version in the classic sense —
it is a long-term project I want to keep developing continuously, expanding and deepening the world step by step.

💬 Want to Help?

Your feedback, ideas, and support are incredibly important.
You can follow the development, milestones, and experiments through the project’s communities and social media.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
